id.description: Unique identifier of the card component

customizedCssClass.description: Css class name to use to customize a specific card's style.

shortValue.description: Whether to format numbers with compact representation (e.g. 1k, 1M)

valuePrecision.description: Number of decimal digits to display

itemPerLine.description: Number of widgets per line in the analytics panel. Valid values: 1, 2, or 3. Default: 1
